lines.t: Hatsune Miku fans keep writing the number 39. Here's why.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live); 39's Giving Day (YouTube)

lines.t: In Japanese, three can be read as mi, and nine can be read as ku. Mi ku.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live); 39's Giving Day (YouTube)

lines.t: Read another way, 39 sounds like san kyu. Thank you.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live); 39's Giving Day (YouTube)

lines.t: So March 9th became Miku Day. In 2010, her first solo concert was even held on that day.
